info.title: Quizymode API
info.description: Quizymode API with JWT Bearer authentication support

post.summary: Add a featured set or collection (Admin only)

get.summary: List all featured items (Admin only)
Get settings for a specific user (Admin only)

put.summary: Update or create a setting for a specific user (Admin only)

get.summary: Get registered users with activity metrics (Admin only)
get.description: Returns a filterable, paged list of registered users plus page-view activity metrics for a selected time window. Activity from internal sessions is excluded unless includeInternal=true.

get.summary: Get page-view activity for a specific user (Admin only)
get.description: Returns grouped URL history and activity summary for one registered user in a selected time window. Hits from internal sessions are excluded unless includeInternal=true.

post.summary: Approve an idea for publication
Create category (Admin only)
Create keyword relation (Admin only)
post.description: Adds a keyword to navigation for a category. ParentKeywordId null = root (rank 1); otherwise rank 2 under that parent. "Other" is not allowed.

post.summary: Create a new public keyword (Admin only)
post.description: Creates a new public keyword. Name must be alphanumeric + hyphens, max 30 chars. Returns 409 if a public keyword with that name already exists.

get.summary: List all keyword relations (Admin only)
get.description: Returns KeywordRelation entries (excluding 'other'). Optional filters: category name, navigation rank, pendingOnly (relations awaiting review).

delete.description: Deletes a category only when it has no items. KeywordRelations for this category are removed.
Removes a keyword relation from navigation for a category. The keyword entity remains.

put.description: Updates a KeywordRelation's parent, sort order, or description. Set Approve=true to make the relation public (IsPrivate=false, IsReviewPending=false).

patch.summary: Update a featured item's display name or sort order (Admin only)

get.summary: Get the acquisition channel report (Admin only)
get.description: Rolls sessions up by acquisition channel, with a nested source/campaign breakdown, plus device-class and country breakdowns. Engaged, bounce, and converted numbers match GET /admin/page-view-sessions for the same window and exclusions. deviceClass and country filters narrow the whole report, not just their own breakdown. Bot sessions are excluded unless includeBots=true, and internal sessions unless includeInternal=true.

get.summary: Get audit logs with filters (Admin only)
get.description: Returns paginated audit logs with optional filtering by action types. Includes user email for logged-in users.

get.summary: List keywords available to add (Admin only)
get.description: Returns keywords that are not yet assigned to this category as navigation keywords, excluding "other".

get.summary: Get front-end errors grouped by fingerprint (Admin only)
get.description: Groups SPA error reports in the selected window by fingerprint with count, affected sessions, first and last seen, latest app version, top paths, browser and device mix, and a sample stack. Optional appVersion filter. Bot reports are excluded unless includeBots=true, and internal sessions unless includeInternal=true.

get.summary: Get content engagement report (Admin only)
get.description: Returns per category, navigation set, and collection engagement, featured click-through, untouched public content, and user-created content by week for the selected window. Bot sessions are excluded unless includeBots=true, and internal sessions unless includeInternal=true.

get.summary: Get the conversion event funnel (Admin only)
get.description: Returns unique sessions and step-to-step conversion for each allowlisted funnel event in the selected window. Bot sessions are excluded unless includeBots=true, and internal sessions unless includeInternal=true.

get.summary: Get current database size (Admin only)
get.description: Returns the current PostgreSQL database size, item and keyword totals, and the largest tables relative to the 500MB free tier limit

get.summary: Get ideas for moderation review
Get study engagement by mode and scope (Admin only)
get.description: Returns quiz and flashcards runs started and completed, average score, items reached, and quiz drop-off by question position for the selected window. Bot sessions are excluded unless includeBots=true, and internal sessions unless includeInternal=true.

get.summary: Get page-view analytics (Admin only)
get.description: Returns summary metrics, usage by feature area and content scope (categories, navigation sets, collections), most visited raw pages, and recent page hits for anonymous and authenticated traffic. Internal sessions are excluded unless includeInternal=true.

get.summary: Get long-range page-view trends from daily rollups (Admin only)
get.description: Returns daily sessions and hits plus totals by feature area, channel, device class, outcome, and new versus returning visitors for up to 730 days, read from daily rollups (bots and internal sessions excluded). Raw page hits are kept for 180 days; use this report for longer ranges.

get.summary: Get the ordered page journey for one session (Admin only)
get.description: Returns every page hit in a session in order, with its feature area and dwell time per step. The final step has no dwell time because no exit event is recorded. Internal sessions return 404 unless includeInternal=true.

get.summary: Get session-level page-view engagement (Admin only)
get.description: Groups page hits into sessions and reports bounce rate, session depth, study activity (sessions with a Quiz or Flashcards question view), landing pages grouped by feature area and content scope, and per-session journeys split by anonymous, converted, and authenticated visitors. Internal sessions are excluded unless includeInternal=true.

get.summary: List private keywords pending review (Admin only)
get.description: Returns private keywords that are marked as review-pending so admins can approve or reject them.

post.summary: Reject an idea submission
Approve a private keyword (Admin only)
post.description: Marks a private keyword as public and clears review-pending state so it no longer appears in the review list.

post.summary: Reject a private keyword (Admin only)
post.description: Keeps the keyword private but clears review-pending state so it no longer appears in the review list.

post.summary: Preview a repo-managed GitHub sync (Admin only)
post.description: Fetches canonical repo-managed items and public collections from GitHub at a specific ref and returns the upsert delta.

post.summary: Apply a repo-managed GitHub sync (Admin only)
post.description: Fetches canonical repo-managed items and public collections from GitHub at a specific ref and upserts them.

get.summary: Get recent repo-managed seed sync history (Admin only)
get.description: Returns the most recent persisted seed sync runs and their affected item changes.

post.summary: Preview a local filesystem seed sync (Admin only)
post.description: Reads seed items from the server's local seed-dev path and returns the upsert delta without applying it.

post.summary: Apply a local filesystem seed sync (Admin only)
post.description: Reads seed items from the server's local seed-dev path and upserts them.

put.summary: Flag or unflag a user as internal traffic (Admin only)
put.description: Internal users' sessions, including earlier ones, are excluded from admin analytics reports unless includeInternal=true.
Updates the name and slug of an existing keyword. Returns 409 if another public keyword already has that name.

post.summary: Record allowlisted engagement events
post.description: Stores up to 25 allowlisted funnel events for an anonymous or authenticated session. Run-scoped events are idempotent per session, event, and run id; events with a clientEventId are idempotent per session, event, and that id. Rate limited.

post.summary: Track a SPA page view
post.description: Stores a page-view event for an anonymous or authenticated SPA route hit. The hit is flagged internal when the caller is an admin, is a user flagged internal, or sends internalBrowser=true. Each hit is classified by feature area and content scope. The first hit of a session also creates an attribution snapshot (channel, referrer host, UTM tags, device class, country).

get.summary: Get unique categories
get.description: Returns unique categories with item counts and average stars, sorted by highest average rating first, then by name.

post.summary: Report a front-end error
post.description: Stores one sanitized, bounded SPA error report for an anonymous or authenticated session and writes a structured warning log with its fingerprint and app version. Accepts a JSON body as application/json or text/plain (navigator.sendBeacon). Text fields are truncated, never rejected for length; query strings, fragments, emails and tokens are removed. The same fingerprint is stored at most once per session and at most 10 reports per session. Rate limited.

post.summary: Create a collection (optionally public for shareable link)

get.summary: Get collections for current user

post.summary: Rate a collection (or update your rating)
post.description: Any authenticated user can rate once per collection (including owner). Stars 1-5.

get.summary: Get collection rating stats and current user's rating

post.summary: Bookmark a collection
Add an item to a collection
post.description: Adds a quiz item to a collection. Body: { "itemId": "<guid>" }.

post.summary: Add multiple items to a collection
post.description: Adds multiple quiz items to a collection. Body: { "itemIds": ["<guid1>", "<guid2>", ...] }.

delete.summary: Remove an item from a collection
delete.description: Removes a quiz item from a collection.

get.summary: Get a collection by ID
get.description: View collection by ID. Allowed if collection is public or you are the owner. Otherwise 404.

get.summary: Search public collections
get.description: Returns public collections matching optional text (name/description), and/or items in the collection matching category, navigation keywords (L1/L2), and item tags.

get.summary: Get collections bookmarked by current user
List users who bookmarked this collection (owner only)

post.summary: Create a comment for an item

get.summary: Get comments
get.description: Returns comments. Optionally filter by itemId using ?itemId={guid}.

get.summary: Get featured sets and collections

post.summary: Create a feedback submission
Create a new idea submission
post.description: Creates a new idea in PendingReview moderation state for the authenticated user.

get.summary: Get the public ideas board
get.description: Returns published ideas with rating and comment summaries.

post.summary: Create a comment on a published idea

get.summary: Get comments for a published idea
Get the current user's ideas
get.description: Returns the authenticated user's ideas across moderation states.

post.summary: Create or update the current user's rating for a published idea
Create a new quiz item

get.summary: Get quiz items with filtering and pagination

post.summary: Create multiple items in bulk
post.description: Creates many items in a single request. Each item specifies its own category; isPrivate applies to all items.

get.summary: Get a single quiz item by id
Export items in seed JSON format

put.summary: Approve an item for review (Admin only)
put.description: No request body. Approves the item (makes it public and removes from review board).

get.summary: Get items ready for review (Admin only)

put.summary: Reject an item from the review board (Admin only)
put.description: Rejects the item, keeps it private, clears ReadyForReview, and appends a rejection note to ReviewComments.
Admin endpoint to promote or demote items between global and private.
Sets the category for an item. Must specify either CategoryId or CategoryName.

post.summary: Upload JSON items into a new collection
post.description: Creates items (private for non-admin) and a new collection with a unique GUID name, adds items to it. Returns collection ID to navigate. URL is shareable.

get.summary: List item tag keyword names for a category
get.description: Returns sorted distinct names of keywords attached to items in the category (extras via ItemKeywords), respecting item and keyword visibility for the current user.

get.summary: Get descriptions for navigation path keywords
get.description: Returns the description for each keyword in the path (for breadcrumb tooltips). Category is the category name. Keywords is comma-separated list of keyword names in path order.

get.summary: Get navigation keywords with aggregates
get.description: Returns the next navigation layer (rank-1 or rank-2 keywords) based on current selection. Includes item counts and average ratings.

post.summary: Create or update a rating for an item
post.description: Creates a new rating or updates existing rating for the current user. Stars can be null or 1-5.

get.summary: Get ratings statistics
get.description: Returns ratings count and average for the specified item.

get.summary: Get current user's rating for an item
get.description: Returns the current user's rating for the specified item. Returns null if no rating exists.

post.summary: Create an import session from current study guide
Finalize import: create items from prompt or dedup results
Generate chunks and prompts for the session

get.summary: Get import session with chunks and results

post.summary: Submit AI response for a chunk
Submit deduplicated AI response

get.summary: Get current user's study guide

put.summary: Create or replace current user's study guide

get.summary: List the current user's recent study sessions
get.description: Newest first. limit defaults to 20 and is capped at 50. Requires authentication.

post.summary: Save a completed quiz run to the current user's history
post.description: Idempotent by run ID: a retry returns the stored session with created=false. Requires authentication.

get.summary: Summary statistics for the current user's study sessions
get.description: Private to the current user; there is no public comparison. Requires authentication.

get.summary: Get category and keyword taxonomy (from YAML, in-memory)
Get all settings for the current user
get.description: Retrieves all user-specific settings. Returns an empty dictionary if no settings exist. Requires authentication.

put.summary: Update or create a user setting
put.description: Updates an existing setting or creates a new one if it doesn't exist. Requires authentication.

get.summary: Check if username and/or email are available
get.description: Checks if the provided username and/or email are already registered. Returns availability status for each.

get.summary: Get the currently authenticated user
get.description: Returns the current user's profile information including name, email, role, and timestamps

put.summary: Update the name for the currently authenticated user

get.summary: Get a user by their ID
get.description: Admin only endpoint to get user details by ID

post.summary: Log login failure event
post.description: Logs a LoginFailed audit event. Can be called by anonymous users. Email is optional for privacy.

post.summary: Log user logout event
post.description: Logs a logout audit event for the current user. This should be called before the client signs out.

post.summary: Record policy acceptance(s) for the currently authenticated user
post.description: Creates auditable acceptance records keyed by user, policy type, and policy version. Repeating the same acceptance is idempotent.

newGroups.description: Groups whose first report ever (within retention) falls inside the window.

truncated.description: True when the window held more than int GetClientErrors.MaxRows reports and only the latest were aggregated.

key.description: Category slug, navigation path (category/keyword/keyword), or collection id.

studySessions.description: Sessions with a Quiz or Flashcards page hit in this scope.

oneOf.description: Collections only; null for categories and navigation sets.
Collections only; null for categories and navigation sets.
Completed quiz runs; null when the scope has no recorded quiz runs.

sessionsSeen.description: Sessions that viewed home or the Featured page.

sessionsOpened.description: Of those, sessions that then opened this entry's scope in the same session.

oneOf.description:
Unique sessions at this step as a share of the previous step's; null for the first step or
when the previous step has no sessions. Steps are counted independently, so a later step can
exceed an earlier one (for example sign-ins by returning users who never saw a prompt).

runsReached.description: Started quiz runs that answered at least Position questions.

runsAbandonedHere.description: Unfinished quiz runs whose furthest answered question is Position.

oneOf.description: Quiz runs that reached every question; null for flashcards, which have no completion.
Mean of score / total over completed quiz runs; null when none completed.

averageItemsReached.description: Mean questions answered (quiz) or cards revealed (flashcards) per started run.

key.description: Category slug, navigation path (category/kw1/kw2), or collection id.

oneOf.description: Resolved collection name; null for categories, navigation paths, and deleted collections.

area.description: Feature area from the page-hit classifier; unclassified rows count as `other`.

hits.description: Hits in this area. Across all areas these add up to `Summary.TotalPageViews`.

sessions.description: Distinct sessions with at least one hit in this area.

sessionSharePercent.description: Sessions as a percentage of all sessions; a session can touch several areas.

itemSteps.description: Quiz/Flashcards question views (item-step hits) in this area.

sessionDays.description: Sum over days of the distinct sessions that touched this area that day.

oneOf.description: Most recent UTC day with rollup rows; null when nothing has been rolled up yet.

totalSessionDays.description: Sum of each day's distinct sessions; a session spanning midnight counts once per day.

Quizymode.Api.Features.Admin.GetPageView.description: Hits and item steps per category or collection (sessions are not additive across areas, so not reported).

path.description: The most common entry path in the group, as an example.

Quizymode.Api.Features.Admin.GetPageView.description: Landing sessions grouped by the entry hit's feature area and content scope (ANALYTICS-004).

oneOf.description: Optional client id for one UI impression or action; repeats within the session are ignored.
Client-asserted internal-browser marker, as on page views; it can only remove the sender's own events from reports.

Browser visitor id (ANALYTICS-003). A syntactically invalid value is ignored, not rejected. When the
session already has an attribution row with no visitor id, it is filled in from here.

Client-asserted internal-browser marker (set by an admin on their own devices and by E2E runs).
Trusting it is safe because it can only remove the sender's own traffic from reports.

Client-generated id persisted in the visitor's browser (localStorage), used to recognize a
returning visitor across sessions (TRAFFIC-122). Must be a syntactically valid UUID; an
invalid value is ignored (treated as absent) rather than rejecting the hit.
Raw referrer URL reported by the client for the first hit of a session.
Client-asserted internal-browser marker, as on page views (#121); it can only remove the sender's own errors from reports.

stored.description: False when the same error was already stored for this session, or the session hit its limit.

oneOf.description: `duplicate` or `session_limit` when not stored (`global_limit` is answered with 429).

Quizymode.Api.Features.Items.UploadToCol.description: InputText is the raw upload content (e.g. JSON string) used to compute a hash for duplicate detection. Category, Keyword1, Keyword2 define navigation; Keywords are additional default keywords for all items.

Quizymode.Api.Features.Keywords.GetKeywo.description: Response DTO for a navigation keyword with aggregates.

Quizymode.Api.Features.UserSettings.GetU.description: Response containing all settings for the current user as a dictionary of key-value pairs.

Quizymode.Api.Features.UserSettings.Upda.description: Request DTO for updating a user setting. Contains the setting key and value to store.
Response DTO containing the updated setting information.

newVisitorSessions.description: Window sessions with a visitor id whose visitor had no earlier session.

returningVisitorSessions.description: Window sessions whose visitor had an earlier session (possibly before the window).

unidentifiedSessions.description: Window sessions with no visitor id (Global Privacy Control, storage unavailable, or history); counted as neither.

newVisitors.description: Distinct visitors whose first-ever session is in the window.

returningVisitors.description: Distinct visitors with a window session whose first-ever session predates the window.

returnWithin7Days.description: First-time visitors in the window, grouped by their first session's channel and campaign.

signupsWithVisitorHistory.description: Accounts created in the window that are linked to a visitor id.

oneOf.description: Average sessions before the signup session; null when no signups qualify.
Median sessions before the signup session; null when no signups qualify.
Average UTC calendar days from first visit to account creation; null when no signups qualify.
Median UTC calendar days from first visit to account creation; null when no signups qualify.

channel.description: Channel of the visitor's first session.

oneOf.description: Campaign of the visitor's first session, when tagged.

firstTimeVisitors.description: Visitors whose first-ever session is in the window with this channel and campaign.

returnedWithin7Days.description: Those with another session that started within 7 days after the first one.

returnRatePercent.description: ReturnedWithin7Days as a percentage of FirstTimeVisitors.

Bearer.description: JWT Authorization header using the Bearer scheme. Example: "Bearer {token}"
